"""Freeze the 499/501 ft linked probes from the proven 500 ft source pattern."""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
PREFIX = HERE.name + "__traveling_follow_"


def put(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def once(value, original, replacement):
    if value.count(original) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly one selected source edit: " + original)
    return value.replace(original, replacement)


def construction_for(base, target):
    result = deepcopy(base)
    result["case_id"] = PREFIX + str(target) + "ft"
    files = {item["path"]: item for item in result["files"]}
    runner = files["runner.py"]["content"]
    runner = once(runner, 'CASE_SUFFIX = "__traveling_follow_500ft"',
                  'CASE_SUFFIX = "__traveling_follow_' + str(target) + 'ft"')
    runner = once(runner, 'config.get("target_distance_ft") != 500',
                  'config.get("target_distance_ft") != ' + str(target))
    runner = runner.replace('target_gap_ft=500', 'target_gap_ft=' + str(target))
    files["runner.py"]["content"] = runner
    test = files["tests/test_runner.py"]["content"]
    test = test.replace("__traveling_follow_500ft", "__traveling_follow_" + str(target) + "ft")
    test = once(test, '"target_distance_ft": 500',
                '"target_distance_ft": ' + str(target))
    test = once(test, 'config["target_distance_ft"] = 499',
                'config["target_distance_ft"] = ' + str(target + 2))
    files["tests/test_runner.py"]["content"] = test
    config = json.loads(files["config.json"]["content"])
    config["selected_case_id"] = result["case_id"]
    config["target_distance_ft"] = target
    config["case"]["case_id"] = result["case_id"]
    files["config.json"]["content"] = json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n"
    return result


def diagnostic_for(base, target, destination):
    spec = deepcopy(base)
    files = spec["files"]
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in files["participant_footprints.jsonl"].splitlines()]
    shift_m = (target - 500) / 3.280839895013123
    for row in rows:
        for corner in row["apparatus_corners"]:
            corner[0] += shift_m
    files["participant_footprints.jsonl"] = "".join(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for row in rows)
    manifest = json.loads(files["capture/manifest.json"])
    manifest["case_id"] = PREFIX + str(target) + "ft"
    files["capture/manifest.json"] = json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n"
    provenance = json.loads(files["fixture-provenance.json"])
    provenance["case_id"] = manifest["case_id"]
    files["fixture-provenance.json"] = json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n"
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(spec, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    relative = destination.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    return {"format": "worker-fixture-recipe",
            "sources": [{"path": "diagnostic-input.json", "source": relative,
                         "sha256": digest(destination)}],
            "generator": {"source": relative, "sha256": digest(destination)}}


def main():
    manifest_path = HERE / "execution-manifest.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    existing = {item["case_id"]: item for item in manifest["cases"]}
    first = existing[PREFIX + "500ft"]
    primary = json.loads((HERE / first["construction"]).read_text())
    fallbacks = {item["id"]: json.loads((HERE / item["construction"]).read_text())
                 for item in first["candidates"]}
    base_diagnostic = json.loads((HERE / "diagnostic-input.json").read_text())
    base_contract = json.loads((HERE / "first-measurement-contract.json").read_text())
    proposal_path = HERE / "proposals/cases.json"
    proposal = json.loads(proposal_path.read_text())
    proposal_cases = {item["case_id"]: item for item in proposal["cases"]}
    plan_path = HERE / "case-plan.json"
    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    for target in (499, 500, 501):
        case_id = PREFIX + str(target) + "ft"
        case = proposal_cases.get(case_id, deepcopy(proposal_cases[PREFIX + "500ft"]))
        case["case_id"] = case_id
        case["rationale"] = "Measure traveling-apparatus full-body gap at the " + str(target) + " ft engineering command against the statutory 500 ft boundary"
        case["variable_assignments"]["target_distance_ft"]["value"] = target
        case["paired_probe_id"] = "traveling_500_boundary"
        case["epsilon_used"] = 1
        case["probe"] = {"threshold_ref": "NRS 484B.710 traveling-follow distance",
                         "operator": "<", "unit": "ft", "test_value": target}
        proposal_cases[case_id] = case
    proposal["cases"] = [proposal_cases[key] for key in (PREFIX + "499ft", PREFIX + "500ft", PREFIX + "501ft")]
    put(proposal_path, proposal)
    plan["requirement_dispositions"][0]["case_ids"] = [PREFIX + str(n) + "ft" for n in (499, 500, 501)]
    entries = [first]
    for target in (499, 501):
        case_id = PREFIX + str(target) + "ft"
        folder = HERE / "cases" / ("traveling_follow_" + str(target) + "ft")
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        primary_path = folder / "construction.json"
        put(primary_path, construction_for(primary, target))
        diagnostic_path = folder / "diagnostic.json"
        recipe_path = folder / "diagnostic-recipe.json"
        put(recipe_path, diagnostic_for(base_diagnostic, target, diagnostic_path))
        contract = deepcopy(base_contract)
        contract["case_id"] = case_id
        put(folder / "measurement-contract.json", contract)
        entry = {
            "case_id": case_id, "kind": "delivery",
            "construction": primary_path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
            "construction_sha256": digest(primary_path),
            "measurement_contract": (folder / "measurement-contract.json").relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
            "measurement_procedure": {"entrypoint": "fire_finalizer.py"},
            "fixture_recipe": recipe_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "native_handoff": deepcopy(first["native_handoff"]),
            "candidate_risk": deepcopy(first["candidate_risk"]),
            "acquisition": deepcopy(first["acquisition"]),
            "candidates": [],
        }
        old = existing.get(case_id)
        if old and old.get("construction_sha256") == entry["construction_sha256"]:
            for key in ("offline", "compatibility", "negative", "post_capture"):
                if key in old:
                    entry[key] = old[key]
        old_candidates = {item["id"]: item for item in old.get("candidates", [])} if old else {}
        for ident in ("fallback1", "fallback2", "fallback3"):
            candidate_path = folder / (ident + "-construction.json")
            put(candidate_path, construction_for(fallbacks[ident], target))
            source = next(item for item in first["candidates"] if item["id"] == ident)
            candidate = {"id": ident,
                         "construction": candidate_path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
                         "construction_sha256": digest(candidate_path),
                         "trigger": deepcopy(source["trigger"]),
                         "changed_knobs": deepcopy(source["changed_knobs"])}
            prior = old_candidates.get(ident)
            if prior and prior.get("construction_sha256") == candidate["construction_sha256"]:
                for key in ("offline", "compatibility"):
                    if key in prior:
                        candidate[key] = prior[key]
            entry["candidates"].append(candidate)
        entries.append(entry)
        next(item for item in plan["cases"] if item["case_id"] == case_id)["construction_status"] = "exact_bundle_pending_proofs"
    next(item for item in plan["cases"] if item["case_id"] == PREFIX + "500ft")["construction_status"] = "exact_bundle_software_proved"
    put(plan_path, plan)
    manifest["cases"] = entries + [item for item in manifest["cases"]
                                    if item["case_id"] not in {entry["case_id"] for entry in entries}]
    put(manifest_path, manifest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Create a case-specific textual software diagnostic from the pinned schema seed.

The seed supplies only Native-shaped trace/graph structure and four synthetic
videos. Fire distance, participant state and dispatch context below are newly
authored inputs for testing this finalizer; none is physical evidence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
CASE = HERE.name + "__traveling_follow_500ft"


def lines(rows):
    return "".join(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for row in rows)


def box(x0, x1, y):
    return [[x0, y-1], [x1, y-1], [x1, y+1], [x0, y+1]]


def main():
    spec = json.loads((ROOT / "runtime/fixtures/example.json").read_text())
    files = spec["files"]
    mapping = [json.loads(s) for s in files["video_frames.jsonl"].splitlines()]
    trace = [json.loads(s) for s in files["trace.jsonl"].splitlines()]
    if len(mapping) != len(trace) or len(mapping) != 9:
        raise ValueError("Pinned schema seed changed")
    feet_per_metre = 3.280839895013123
    footprints, state = [], []
    for frame, point in zip(mapping, trace):
        if frame["carla_frame"] != point["frame"] or frame["time_s"] != point["time_s"]:
            raise ValueError("Schema seed frame identity changed")
        x, y = point["position"]["x"], point["position"]["y"]
        apparatus_near = x + 2 + 500 / feet_per_metre
        footprints.append({
            "frame": point["frame"], "time_s": point["time_s"],
            "ego_id": "ego", "apparatus_id": "apparatus",
            "ego_corners": box(x-2, x+2, y),
            "apparatus_corners": box(apparatus_near, apparatus_near+6, y),
        })
        state.append({
            "frame": point["frame"], "time_s": point["time_s"],
            "apparatus_moving": True, "ego_moving": True,
            "ego_following": True, "ego_parked": False,
            "warning_lamp": True, "siren": None,
        })
    files["participant_footprints.jsonl"] = lines(footprints)
    files["participant_state.jsonl"] = lines(state)
    config = json.loads((HERE / "config.json").read_text())
    files["fire_context.json"] = json.dumps(config["fire_context"], indent=2) + "\n"
    manifest = json.loads(files["capture/manifest.json"])
    manifest["case_id"] = CASE
    manifest["source_run"] = "synthetic-fire-distance-software-diagnostic"
    manifest["required_observations"] = config["required_atoms"]
    files["capture/manifest.json"] = json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n"
    files["fixture-provenance.json"] = json.dumps({
        "scope": "Synthetic software diagnostic; original schema seed supplies graph and trace shape only.",
        "case_id": CASE,
        "fire_measurement_source": "participant_footprints.jsonl and participant_state.jsonl in this diagnostic",
        "physical_evidence": False,
    }, indent=2) + "\n"
    # Remove the speed-law example's measurements and context. Native graph and
    # trace shapes remain only to exercise the frozen converter/renderer.
    for key in ("alley_context.json", "body_history.jsonl", "speed_samples.jsonl"):
        files.pop(key, None)
    spec_path = HERE / "diagnostic-input.json"
    spec_path.write_text(json.dumps(spec, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    relative = spec_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    digest = sha256(spec_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    recipe = {"format": "worker-fixture-recipe",
              "sources": [{"path": "diagnostic-input.json", "source": relative,
                           "sha256": digest}],
              "generator": {"source": relative, "sha256": digest}}
    (HERE / "diagnostic-recipe.json").write_text(json.dumps(recipe, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run and bind exact-case CPU acceptance fixtures, including stale-source rejection."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = folder.parents[1]
manifest_path = folder / 'execution-manifest.json'
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
logs = folder / 'acceptance'
logs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
script = folder / 'acceptance_fixture.py'
script_sha = hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

for entry in manifest['cases']:
    case = entry['case_id']
    stem = case.split('__')[-1]
    commands = {}
    for negative in (False, True):
        key = 'negative' if negative else 'positive'
        command = [str(repo / '.venv-cpu/bin/python'), str(script), '--case', case]
        if negative:
            command.append('--negative')
        outcome = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, check=False)
        log = logs / f'{stem}-{key}.log'
        log.write_text(outcome.stdout)
        if (negative and (outcome.returncode == 0 or 'stale' not in outcome.stdout)) or (not negative and outcome.returncode != 0):
            raise ValueError(f'{case} {key} fixture failed: {outcome.stdout[-700:]}')
        commands[key] = (command, outcome, log)
    pos, neg = commands['positive'], commands['negative']
    entry['delivery_acceptance'] = {
        'case_id': case, 'sets': ['held-out'],
        'checks': ['native_source', 'all_participants', 'time_join',
                   'full_video_decode', 'actual_pixels', 'physical_completion'],
        'command': '.venv-cpu/bin/python work/' + folder.name + '/acceptance_fixture.py --case ' + case,
        'test_exit_code': 0,
        'test_log': str(pos[2].relative_to(folder)), 'test_log_sha256': sha(pos[2]),
        'negative_command': '.venv-cpu/bin/python work/' + folder.name + '/acceptance_fixture.py --case ' + case + ' --negative',
        'negative_exit_code': neg[1].returncode, 'negative_expected_error': 'stale',
        'negative_log': str(neg[2].relative_to(folder)), 'negative_log_sha256': sha(neg[2]),
        'script': script.name, 'script_sha256': script_sha,
        'fixture_only': True,
    }
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
print('Bound source-decoding and stale-source fixture proofs for', len(manifest['cases']), 'exact cases')

"""Freeze stopped drive-to 450 ft as the first stopped exact CPU bundle."""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
CASE = HERE.name + "__stopped_drive_to_450ft"
DEST = HERE / "cases/stopped_drive_to_450ft"


def put(path, value, *, compact=False):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":") if compact else None,
                               indent=None if compact else 2) + "\n")


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(value):
    return "".join(json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for item in value)


def box(center, half):
    return [[center-half, -1], [center+half, -1],
            [center+half, 1], [center-half, 1]]


def main():
    DEST.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    first = json.loads((HERE / "config.json").read_text())
    recording = {
        "channels": [{"name": "fire_centre_distance_ft", "unit": "ft",
                      "method": "original-frame world center distance from retained Native footprints",
                      "sampling_rate_hz": 20, "time_window": "all original frames",
                      "reference_frame": "world ground plane",
                      "uncertainty": "Native vertex precision and 20 Hz temporal sampling"}],
        "context_inputs": [],
        "limitations": ["Alarm purpose is an authored premise; actual stopped state, closing motion and camera visibility need Native review."],
    }
    config = deepcopy(first)
    config.update(selected_case_id=CASE, fire_branch="stopped_drive_to",
                  target_distance_ft=450, frames=160, duration_s=8)
    config["case"] = {"case_id": CASE, "recording_description": recording}
    config["fire_context"]["alarm_response_source"] = "authored stopped fire-alarm dispatch premise; verify against local Native scene record"
    config["fire_context"]["apparatus_answered_alarm"] = True
    put(DEST / "config.json", config)
    sources = ["stopped_runner.py", "fire_route.py", "fire_camera_capture.py",
               "fire_capture_session.py", "fire_source_capture.py",
               "stopped_controller.py", "fire_finalizer.py", "stopped_finalizer.py",
               "fire_branch.py", "fire_distance.py"]
    tests = ["tests/test_stopped_runner.py", "tests/test_stopped_controller.py",
             "tests/test_stopped_finalizer.py", "tests/test_fire_route.py",
             "tests/test_fire_capture_session.py"]
    files = [{"path": "runner.py", "content": (HERE / "stopped_runner.py").read_text()}]
    files += [{"path": name, "content": (HERE / name).read_text()} for name in sources]
    files += [{"path": name, "content": (HERE / name).read_text()} for name in tests]
    files.append({"path": "config.json", "content": (DEST / "config.json").read_text()})
    construction = {
        "format": "worker-inline-construction", "case_id": CASE,
        "law_id": "NRS-484B-710", "cell_id": "C102304",
        "actor": "motor_vehicle_driver", "entrypoint": "runner.py",
        "files": files, "recording_description": recording,
        "measurement_plan": {"finalizer": "stopped_finalizer.py",
                             "retained_sources": ["video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl",
                                                  "participant_footprints.jsonl",
                                                  "participant_state.jsonl", "fire_context.json"],
                             "reported_boundary": "minimum active-frame world center distance in feet"},
        "static_checks": ["stopped runner --check", "materialized fake-world CPU tests"],
        "termination_rules": ["160 original 20 Hz frames", "reject missing synchronized source camera frame"],
        "mechanisms": ["stationary fire apparatus", "measured closing approach controller",
                       "four original RGB sources", "saved-only center distance finalization"],
    }
    put(DEST / "construction.json", construction)
    # Build a small synthetic fire source history while retaining only the
    # pinned graph/trace schema scaffolding for converter compatibility.
    spec = json.loads((HERE / "diagnostic-input.json").read_text())
    source = spec["files"]
    trace = [json.loads(line) for line in source["trace.jsonl"].splitlines()]
    mapping = [json.loads(line) for line in source["video_frames.jsonl"].splitlines()]
    if len(trace) != 9 or len(mapping) != 9:
        raise ValueError("Diagnostic schema seed changed")
    ego_centers = [row["position"]["x"] + index * .3
                   for index, row in enumerate(trace)]
    apparatus_center = ego_centers[-1] + 450 / 3.280839895013123
    footprints = []
    state = []
    for index, (point, frame) in enumerate(zip(trace, mapping)):
        footprints.append({"frame": frame["carla_frame"], "time_s": frame["time_s"],
                           "ego_id": "ego", "apparatus_id": "apparatus",
                           "ego_corners": box(ego_centers[index], 2),
                           "apparatus_corners": box(apparatus_center, 3)})
        state.append({"frame": frame["carla_frame"], "time_s": frame["time_s"],
                      "apparatus_moving": False, "ego_moving": True,
                      "ego_following": False, "ego_parked": False,
                      "warning_lamp": True, "siren": None})
    source["participant_footprints.jsonl"] = rows(footprints)
    source["participant_state.jsonl"] = rows(state)
    source["fire_context.json"] = json.dumps(config["fire_context"], indent=2) + "\n"
    capture = json.loads(source["capture/manifest.json"])
    capture["case_id"] = CASE
    source["capture/manifest.json"] = json.dumps(capture, indent=2) + "\n"
    provenance = json.loads(source["fixture-provenance.json"])
    provenance["case_id"] = CASE
    provenance["scope"] = "Synthetic stopped-apparatus software diagnostic; not physical evidence"
    source["fixture-provenance.json"] = json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n"
    diagnostic = DEST / "diagnostic.json"
    put(diagnostic, spec, compact=True)
    relative = diagnostic.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    put(DEST / "diagnostic-recipe.json",
        {"format": "worker-fixture-recipe",
         "sources": [{"path": "diagnostic-input.json", "source": relative,
                      "sha256": digest(diagnostic)}],
         "generator": {"source": relative, "sha256": digest(diagnostic)}})
    plan_path = HERE / "case-plan.json"
    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    requirement = "driving to a fire apparatus stopped in answer to an alarm within the 500 ft boundary"
    source_ref = "NRS 484B.710 full text in inputs/" + HERE.name + "/assignment.json"
    disposition = {"requirement": requirement, "source": source_ref,
                   "status": "selected_required", "case_ids": [CASE],
                   "evidence_or_gap": "Accepted traveling-follow originals do not establish stationary apparatus or measured drive-to closing."}
    matching = [index for index, item in enumerate(plan["requirement_dispositions"])
                if item["requirement"] == requirement]
    if matching:
        index = matching[0]
        if plan["requirement_dispositions"][index] != disposition:
            raise ValueError("Existing stopped drive-to disposition changed")
    else:
        index = len(plan["requirement_dispositions"])
        plan["requirement_dispositions"].append(disposition)
    next(item for item in plan["cases"] if item["case_id"] == CASE)["construction_status"] = "exact_bundle_pending_proofs"
    put(plan_path, plan)
    contract = deepcopy(json.loads((HERE / "first-measurement-contract.json").read_text()))
    contract["case_id"] = CASE
    contract["requirements"][0].update(disposition_index=index,
                                       requirement=requirement, source=source_ref)
    put(DEST / "measurement-contract.json", contract)
    proposal_path = HERE / "proposals/cases.json"
    proposal = json.loads(proposal_path.read_text())
    if not any(item["case_id"] == CASE for item in proposal["cases"]):
        proposal["cases"].append({"case_id": CASE, "target_law_id": "NRS-484B-710",
                                  "target_type": "boundary_probe", "rationale": requirement,
                                  "paired_probe_id": "stopped_drive_to_500_boundary",
                                  "variable_assignments": {"target_centre_ft": {"kind": "controller", "value": 450}},
                                  "unresolved_judgment_calls": [],
                                  "recording_description": recording})
        put(proposal_path, proposal)
    manifest_path = HERE / "execution-manifest.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    entry = {"case_id": CASE, "kind": "delivery",
             "construction": (DEST / "construction.json").relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
             "construction_sha256": digest(DEST / "construction.json"),
             "measurement_contract": (DEST / "measurement-contract.json").relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
             "measurement_procedure": {"entrypoint": "stopped_finalizer.py"},
             "fixture_recipe": (DEST / "diagnostic-recipe.json").relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
             "native_handoff": {"python_env_var": "CARLA_PYTHON",
                                "host_env_var": "CARLA_HOST", "port_env_var": "CARLA_PORT"},
             "candidate_risk": {"status": "physical",
                                "reason": "Native stationary apparatus or closing approach may not settle at the measured 450 ft centre target"},
             "acquisition": {"fire_centre_distance_ft": {
                 "entrypoint": "stopped_finalizer.py",
                 "method": "recompute original-frame centers from retained Native footprints",
                 "evidence": "FireCaptureSession writes original footprints/state and synchronized frame identities; stopped finalizer derives the centre stream."}},
             "candidates": []}
    prior = next((item for item in manifest["cases"] if item["case_id"] == CASE), None)
    if prior and prior.get("construction_sha256") == entry["construction_sha256"]:
        for key in ("offline", "compatibility", "negative", "post_capture", "candidates"):
            if key in prior:
                entry[key] = prior[key]
    manifest["cases"] = [item for item in manifest["cases"] if item["case_id"] != CASE] + [entry]
    put(manifest_path, manifest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Three distinct physical-risk alternatives for stopped drive-to 450 ft."""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = HERE.name + "__stopped_drive_to_450ft"
FOLDER = HERE / "cases/stopped_drive_to_450ft"


def once(text, before, after):
    if text.count(before) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Stopped candidate knob not unique: " + before)
    return text.replace(before, after)


def main():
    primary = json.loads((FOLDER / "construction.json").read_text())

def put(path, value):
